advantages.0.title: Exceptional Energy Efficiency
advantages.0.desc: Multi-effect design achieves steam economy of 2.2 - 6.5, reducing steam consumption by up to 85% versus single-effect systems. TVR option reduces steam consumption, MVR option virtually eliminates steam requirement.
advantages.1.title: Gentle Product Treatment
advantages.1.desc: Short residence time (seconds) and low evaporation temperatures protect heat-sensitive components - vitamins, proteins, flavors and colors remain intact.
advantages.2.title: Wide Capacity Range
advantages.2.desc: Modular design allows capacity from 500 L/hr to 50,000 L/hr in a single unit, with further scale-up through parallel trains.
advantages.3.title: Continuous Operation
advantages.3.desc: Designed for 24/7 continuous operation with minimal maintenance. Automated CIP cycles keep downtime to a minimum.
advantages.4.title: Standards Compliance
advantages.4.desc: Manufactured to ASME Section VIII, 3-A sanitary standards (dairy), GMP guidelines (pharma), and all relevant BIS/IS Indian standards.
advantages.5.title: Low Maintenance
advantages.5.desc: Simple mechanical design with no moving parts in the evaporator body. Predictive maintenance enabled through online monitoring instruments.
how.0.title: Feed Distribution
how.0.desc: The liquid feed is preheated and fed to the top distribution tray of the evaporator. A patented distribution system ensures uniform, even distribution of liquid to all tubes - preventing dry spots and ensuring consistent film formation.
how.1.title: Formação e Evaporação de Filme
how.1.desc: The liquid flows downward under gravity as a thin film on the inner tube wall. Steam condensing on the shell side transfers heat through the tube wall to the falling liquid film, causing rapid evaporation of water at the film surface.
how.2.title: Vapor-Liquid Separation
how.2.desc: At the bottom of the tubes, concentrated liquid and generated vapors exit together and enter the vapor-liquid separator. The separator efficiently separates the vapor (secondary steam) from the concentrated product liquid.
how.3.title: Multi-Effect Vapor Reuse
how.3.desc: In multi-effect systems, the secondary steam generated in Effect 1 is used as the heating medium for Effect 2 (operating at lower temperature/pressure), and so on. This cascading of vapor energy dramatically reduces total steam consumption.
how.4.title: Condensate & Product Discharge
how.4.desc: Vapor from the final effect is condensed in a barometric or surface condenser. Steam condensate is recovered and reused. The concentrated product at target Total Solids content is discharged via a density/Brix-controlled outlet pump.
how.5.title: Thermo Vapour Recompressor (TVR)
how.5.desc: A Thermo Vapour Recompressor (TVR) uses high-pressure motive steam in a steam jet ejector to compress low-pressure vapor from an effect, raising its pressure and temperature so it can be reused as heating steam in the same or preceding effect. This boosts steam economy beyond standard multi-effect operation while keeping investment lower than full MVR systems.
how.6.title: Mechanical Vapour Recompressor (MVR)
how.6.desc: A Mechanical Vapour Recompressor (MVR) system uses a centrifugal or roots-type compressor driven by an electric motor to compress evaporator vapor, increasing its saturation temperature so the same vapor can serve as the sole heating medium. MVR plants can operate with minimal or zero live steam, delivering the highest energy efficiency for large-capacity falling film evaporators.

tagline: Evaporação suave e de alta eficiência para produtos sensíveis ao calor.
overview.p0: O Evaporador de Filme Descendente Gausin é um trocador de calor orientado verticalmente onde a alimentação líquida é distribuída uniformemente sobre a folha superior do tubo e flui para baixo como uma película fina nas superfícies internas do tubo.
overview.p1: Este design permite a evaporação a temperaturas relativamente baixas (através da operação a vácuo), tornando-o ideal para produtos sensíveis ao calor, como leite, sucos de frutas, soluções farmacêuticas e líquidos químicos.
overview.p2: Os sistemas FFE da Gausin são projetados usando simulação de processo CHEMCAD e software de projeto térmico HTRI, garantindo cálculos precisos de transferência de calor, dimensões ideais de tubos e desempenho garantido desde o primeiro dia.
